mechanics.summary: Pushing a skill roll that uses INT or EMP inflicts 1 stress per bane on base dice.
trigger: INT or EMP skill roll pushed

mechanics.summary: A critical injury’s listed effect lasts through its listed healing time; multiple critical injuries heal simultaneously and permanent injuries never heal.

outcome.value: retain listed effect until healing completes

mechanics.summary: Critical-injury skill modifiers are cumulative and apply even without the skill.
trigger: skill roll while critical-injury modifiers exist

outcome.value: sum all applicable critical-injury skill modifiers

mechanics.summary: If someone tends a critical-injury patient for one shift per day and succeeds at MEDICAL AID, that day counts double toward healing.

outcome.value: count day as 2 days of healing

mechanics.summary: A same-hex helper can use slow-action MEDICAL AID on a damage-incapacitated target; success immediately heals damage equal to successes.
exceptions: Further Medical Aid has no effect unless advanced medical gear is applied or target is incapacitated again.
The same person cannot try again until then.

mechanics.summary: A damage-incapacitated target with no help within one shift recovers and heals 1 damage.
trigger: one shift passes after damage incapacitation without help

mechanics.summary: A non-incapacitated character heals 1 remaining damage per full shift resting or sleeping.
exceptions: Does not apply while starving, dehydrated, or hypothermic.
Damage and stress can heal at the same time.

mechanics.summary: External-attack damage of at least 1 needs MEDICAL AID within one shift or an infection roll; antibiotics give +3 and a non-incapacitated target may self-treat.
trigger: external attack inflicts at least 1 damage

mechanics.summary: Mental-trauma D10 table defines ongoing effects.

value.4: CUF each sleep shift; failure means sleep does not count
value.5: Sleep only morning and day shifts
value.6: 1 stress each round in same hex as phobia object
value.7: 1 stress and no stress recovery each shift without alcohol
value.9: EMP attribute roll each shift; failure triggers violent rampage

unknowns: Phobia object and paranoia effects require player/Referee input.

mechanics.summary: A same-hex helper can use slow-action COMMAND on a stress-incapacitated target; success immediately heals stress equal to successes.
exceptions: Further Command rolls have no effect; same helper cannot try again until next stress incapacitation.

mechanics.summary: Without help within one stretch, a stress-incapacitated character recovers and heals 1 stress.
trigger: one stretch passes after stress incapacitation without help

mechanics.summary: A non-incapacitated character heals 1 remaining stress for each full shift resting or sleeping.
exceptions: Does not apply while sleep deprived or hypothermic.
Stress and damage can heal at the same time.

mechanics.summary: After each stress incapacitation, make an EMP attribute-only roll at next shift rest or sleep; success creates mental trauma rolled on the Mental table.
trigger: stress-incapacitated character next rests or sleeps one shift

mechanics.summary: Long-term trauma needs at least one shift of counseling and MEDICAL AID to heal; only one attempt per week is allowed.
exceptions: Long-term trauma is permanent unless helped.

mechanics.summary: After a full day without a food ration, a character becomes starving.
Starving blocks damage healing, causes 1 damage weekly, and kills a damage-incapacitated character after another week without food.
exceptions: Stress recovery continues normally.
Eating ends starving and restores normal damage healing.

mechanics.summary: After a day without a water ration, a character becomes dehydrated.
Dehydration blocks damage healing, causes 1 damage daily, and kills a damage-incapacitated character after another day without water.
exceptions: Stress recovery continues normally.
Drinking ends dehydration and restores normal damage healing.

mechanics.summary: After one day without at least one shift of sleep, a character becomes sleep deprived.
Sleep deprivation blocks stress healing, causes 1 stress daily, and makes a stress-incapacitated character sleep at least one shift and impossible to wake during it.
exceptions: Sleeping at least one shift ends sleep deprivation and restores stress healing.

mechanics.summary: Without adequate clothing or shelter in bitter cold, make STAMINA rolls at intervals set by cold severity; extra protection can give a bonus.
exceptions: Printed examples are one roll per day in chilly fall, per shift in winter, or per stretch in extreme conditions.

unknowns: Adequacy, interval, and protection bonus are Referee-determined.

mechanics.summary: Hypothermia immediately inflicts 1 damage and 1 stress; each later failed exposure roll repeats both, and blocks damage and stress healing until warmed.
trigger: hypothermic state or failed repeat exposure roll
exceptions: If incapacitated while hypothermic, death occurs at next required roll.

mechanics.summary: A hard-surface fall inflicts damage equal to fall height in meters divided by 2, rounded down; crit threshold is 3 and body armor does not protect.
exceptions: A controlled-jump Mobility success reduces damage by 1 each.

mechanics.summary: A sinking or submerged character rolls MOBILITY each round to hold breath; failure causes drowning and 1 damage each round. A drowning damage-incapacitated character makes death saves each round.

outcome.value: on failed breath roll, drowning and 1 damage per round

exceptions: Rough seas or prolonged water exposure need Mobility to stay afloat.
Rescue requires surfacing and successful slow-action MEDICAL AID.

mechanics.summary: Fire intensity A-D rolls two corresponding base dice; each success inflicts 1 damage and armor does not protect.
Fire damage causes burning; burn attacks recur each turn, intensity rises one step per round to A, and fire ends when an attack inflicts no damage.

outcome.value: burning with repeated escalating fire attacks

exceptions: A same-hex character can use slow-action successful MOBILITY to extinguish; blanket or similar gives +2.

mechanics.summary: At least 2 fire damage in one round causes a lethal fire critical: Stamina and Mobility -2, death save each stretch, healing time 2D6 days.
trigger: fire damage in one round at least 2
exceptions: Do not roll for this critical injury.

mechanics.summary: Chemical round blast power sets contamination radius: A 3 hexes, B 2, C 1 adjacent hex, D target hex only.
At each round start, roll D6 for each sarin-contaminated area; a result of 1 disperses the gas.
In contaminated hex, before actions each turn make STAMINA: unprotected -3, mask 0, basic protective clothing +1, hazmat full protection.
trigger: turn begins in nerve-agent contaminated hex
exceptions: Putting on combat-gear mask is a fast action.

mechanics.summary: Failed nerve-agent exposure inflicts 1 damage and 1 stress immediately and again each later turn even after leaving contamination.
exceptions: Damage incapacitation while affected requires death save every round.

mechanics.summary: Atropine injection is a fast action by self or another, needs no MEDICAL AID roll, ends nerve-agent death saves, and allows normal recovery.

outcome.value: end further death saves and recover normally

mechanics.summary: Within one shift after blister-agent exposure, make STAMINA: unprotected -3, mask 0, basic clothing +1, hazmat automatic success.
trigger: within one shift after blister-agent exposure

mechanics.summary: Failed blister-agent exposure gives 1 damage, 1 stress, and fire-style critical injury with death save each shift; repeat Stamina each shift until success or incapacitation.
exceptions: No damage or stress recovery while affected.
Success or incapacitation ends repeat rolls; critical remains.
Bleach-like chemicals give +2 Medical Aid for the critical.

mechanics.summary: Radiation hotspots give 1 rad per shift when weak, per stretch when strong, or per round when extreme.
exceptions: In a vehicle, radiation frequency is halved.

mechanics.summary: Each gained rad immediately requires STAMINA against radiation sickness with virulence equal to +4 minus total rad count.
When gaining a rad while using protective gear, a successful TECH roll prevents that rad.

unknowns: Which protective gear qualifies is not specified here.

mechanics.summary: After leaving hotspot, lose 1 rad per day; washing in clean water once immediately removes half current rads, rounding fractions up.
exceptions: Wash effect is usable once.

mechanics.summary: Before losing each rad, roll D6; on 1 it remains as a permanent rad for life.
After a disease incubation period, make STAMINA modified by virulence; failure causes illness, 1 damage, and prevents damage healing. Repeat daily until success.
trigger: disease incubation ends or daily while ill

outcome.value: failed roll causes illness and 1 damage

exceptions: Each failed daily roll adds 1 damage.
Damage-incapacitated sick character dies after another day without medical aid.
Success ends illness, stops rolls, and restores normal damage healing.

mechanics.summary: A caregiver can make a disease infection roll using MEDICAL AID modified by virulence; antibiotics add +3 except against viruses and radiation sickness.

outcome.value: Medical Aid substitutes for target infection roll

exceptions: Antibiotics have no effect against viruses or radiation sickness.

mechanics.summary: Disease table defines virulence and incubation.
